cases.initialState: Independent branches start with F, a Cleric7 who actually knows/prepares Alignment Forecast, 21RP and no current price modifier; T is a Wizard9 who actually knows/prepares accepted Alignment Portal and has20RP. T has underlying LawfulEvil and another caster's live Alignment Lock snapshotNeutralGood, with known absolute expiry t30. Both axes and the relevant timing are established and unprotected. Actual different destination plane P/site S is personally known and its established Portal compatibility record admits NeutralGood only. Its clear supported portalPose and the valid clear supported origin pose are already recorded. At t10 F perceives T at20ft with clear LoE. All branches below are independent; one paid Forecast per branch, no accumulation of casts or resources between alternatives.
actionsAndResolution: Branch A asks about T creating a NEW Portal at t20 to reach P/S. F pays7RP,21→14. The supported t20 effective alignment is NeutralGood and the actual compatibility predicate passes. Forecast returns Favored for the alignment contribution only. If that stated cast actually occurs with all other prerequisites still legal, T pays10RP,20→10, forming the portal at t20 with deadline t80.

Branch B instead asks about T creating a NEW Portal at t40. F independently pays7RP,21→14. The known t30 Lock expiry exposes T's actual underlying LawfulEvil, which the recorded site does not admit. Forecast returns Opposed. At the actual known-ineligible t40 preflight T cannot begin that portal cast and spends no10RP; no portal forms. This is not a claim that Forecast itself spends T's resources or guarantees future behavior.

Branch C already has the legally formed Branch-A portal, snapshotNeutralGood and fixed deadline t80. At t30 the Lock expires; the portal remains. T's supported legal physical crossing at t40 is NOT barred by now being LawfulEvil: accepted Alignment Portal has no later traveler-alignment gate. On ordinary clear ground a fitting Medium T uses5 movement through the5x8ft aperture, subject to actual whole-body/ward checks. A new Forecast inquiry about that crossing returns Unaffected for the proposed alignment-change obstruction because that obstruction does not exist; it does not guarantee unrelated transit legality.

Only Favored/Opposed/Unaffected is delivered by the relevant inquiry, not axes, destination coordinates, hidden identities or the causal explanation. Unknown/protected premises would instead require Indeterminate under the procedure. The Portal branches correct only a proposed later traveler-alignment gate. They do not invalidate the separate preserved DE4-06-A scenario involving an actual alignment-based entry ward; that obligation is demonstrated in Branch D below.

Branch D is independent and restores DE4-06-A using actual Alignment Sanctuary Abjuration3, not a Portal traveler gate. At t0 a different Wizard5 with INT16/PB3, Evocation school specialization, actual Sanctuary preparation, 15RP and canonical LawfulGood pays Action/V/S/F/5RP,15→10, to establish a supported fixed10ft-radius/10ft-high Sanctuary with DC14 and absolute expiry t60. Its known Good/Evil opposition at t40 creates the actual WIS entry gate, so Forecast returns Opposed for that alignment contribution, not failure, DC, axes or the ward identity. This remains a forecast, not a simulated future save. If that chosen entry later actually occurs at t40 with these same predicates, T rolls natural8+WIS0=8 versus DC14 and is stopped immediately outside the ward boundary; the established save window persists to T's next regular START, with no repeated save before then. No attack or hard-control claim is created.

historicalOriginalTexts.originalText: An attack made with advantage rolls 4 and 17. A legal Fate Reversal replaces both dice, rather than choosing only the 17, and uses the new selected face even if worse.
If Fate Coin already used the shared allowance on that roll’s lineage, Fate Reversal cannot spend another Reaction or permission to reroll it.
An existing Soul Mark remains recorded but gives no protected bearing. After the seal ends it can resume only if its original deadline and identity still permit.
A protected creature’s ordinary visible body remains visible. An unclassified class sense is not blocked merely because its description resembles divination.
INT 17 becomes 19: its modifier changes from +3 to +4. A dependent spell DC rises by 1, not 2, while current RP stays unchanged.
INT 22 remains 22. Two Aspects do not make it 26 or reduce it to the cap.
An identified creature four miles away behind ordinary walls gives a readable upward/northeast bearing if no actual protection applies.
No Bearing does not establish that a target is dead; protected, ambiguous and out-of-range subjects give the same answer.
An established unprotected secret route used by a faction can supply one concrete route fact for a matching inquiry; a generic public motto does not satisfy that inquiry.
Rephrasing the same question does not rotate through coequal hidden facts. A new subject can be asked with a new paid cast.
An established readable alignment-based ward would hinder the declared attempt to enter: Opposed describes that contribution without identifying the ward or promising failure.
If the required alignment interaction is undefined, the answer is Indeterminate, not a newly invented moral ruling or automatic Unaffected.
If you begin with 11 RP and pay the base 7 to inspect yourself, with no other intervening change, the snapshot is 4 RP.
A readable pool at 0 reports 0. An unreadable or nonexistent pool reports Indeterminate, and does not reveal why.
A controlled humanoid with an ordinary two-attack Attack Action can use that actual sequence, but cannot be forced to spend a charged smite or RP.
A Humanoid companion receives no independent extra turn. Redirection uses its existing owner-linked phase and structural allowances; an unavailable phase grants no execution.
An enemy misses an affected creature with a newly committed weapon attack. That creature’s pacification ends at attack commitment despite the miss.
An insult or an attack against its ally does not release this spell. A nonattack damaging power remains outside its deliberately narrower prohibition, a balance distinction requiring joint review.
A Monk using the Illusion placement must place the center within 10 feet and include all eligible occupants; Wizard Enchantment access does not grant that area mode.
Rolling the attack branch without an available ordinary Action produces no attack and no new roll. The spell does not refund its already established hard-control history.
A Warrior’s solely fear-producing Intimidating Presence cannot activate. A Mooncursed nonfear Howl option remains available at its real cost.
Divine Fury retains its ordinary nonfear benefits, but its new Frightened rider cannot trigger while its owner is affected. Existing fear on another creature keeps its own history.
A creature with 20 feet of remaining movement can be compelled to use at most those 20 feet, not an extra 30.
A known lethal drop blocks that route. The spell grants neither hovering nor a substitute teleport, and does not wait indefinitely for a path to open.
A target immune only to Frightened can still take the independently failed-save psychic damage. Enchantment deals it once; Illusion can repeat within its actual pulse limit.
An Illusion application deals its initial packet, then the target acts later in that numbered round. It receives no second packet that round merely for reaching its regular START.
A creature immune to Charmed gets no separate friendly attitude from a failed roll. A valid friendly relation still cannot force it to surrender a key.
Two qualifying damage packets in the same round grant only the first damage-based save from this application; its scheduled END save remains separate.
An initially failed WIS save establishes Incapacitated and ends ordinary concentration. Removing grief later does not restore that concentration.
Calm Emotions alone does not erase Incapacitated. A positive qualifying damage packet ends this grief application, even if temporary HP absorbs the damage.

historicalOriginalSharedProposal.status: UNADOPTED AND UNSENT. Fifteen proposed mechanical procedures with complete originals and current comparisons. No public spell, class access, review count, source book or cosmology is changed. All added procedures are explicit NEW proposals, not approval or runtime evidence.
historicalOriginalSharedProposal.casting: All fifteen retain Action and V/S/F. Use the actual casting class’s rank, school, minimum class level, independently acquired repertoire and base RP price. A legal cast commits costs, concentration transitions and ordinary Dissonance/Refrain before interruption. Failure, immunity, missing information and countering give no refund or restoration of old concentration. Use actual casting ability + PB for attacks and 8 + PB + that modifier for save DC; ordinary saves are binary. No generic upcast, additional Action or inferred class-card access.
historicalOriginalSharedProposal.time: Unless a card states otherwise, a minute ends at the caster’s tenth future original regular-start marker, excluding a start underway, or after 60 elapsed seconds if begun outside initiative. Retain original virtual markers or absolute deadlines through reorder, extra turns, absence and travel. Suppression never pauses a clock, refunds spent history or replays an application. Later saved-against casts do not dispel an older valid application. Extra turns do not supply extra periodic pulses, order opportunities or repeat saves.
historicalOriginalSharedProposal.information: Use actual established facts and each information protection’s real subject and generating-source scope. Hidden unprotected facts can be read; missing facts are not invented. An unavailable answer does not identify the hidden reason. Ordinary observed outcomes and inferences remain possible. No new faction roster, plane, moral axis, cosmic force, secret doctrine or guaranteed destiny is authored. The pending expedition reputation verdict is not presumed.
historicalOriginalSharedProposal.control: A successfully established hard whole-Action/turn component spends the shared source-character/target/encounter guard once. Its continued valid duration does not claim a new allowance each turn. Initial prevention leaves no banked component; later suppression retains the existing clock and spent history. A blocked component gets no unprinted fallback. Actual component immunities remain separate; creature type alone is no blanket mental immunity. Limited attack or movement restrictions do not become whole-Action denial merely because alternatives are unattractive.
historicalOriginalSharedProposal.newControlBindings: NEW binding for Dominate Person and Confusion: use the reviewed Enchantment compelled-budget arbitration and shared six-second outside-initiative control cycle, preserving already spent budgets on entry to real initiative. A valid order/table instruction receives its priority timestamp when issued or generated at that opportunity; simultaneous instructions use application order then stable source ID. A losing instruction gets no second budget and does not erase an earlier mandate. Actual ordinary Attack Actions use native attacks unless the card expressly limits them to one. Only actual required ordinary ammunition can be compelled; no optional finite resource, spell/RP, recharge, charge, special expendable ammunition, permanent property surrender, protected secret, knowing binding-oath violation, direct self-harm or knowingly suicidal route can be forced. Bonus Actions, Reactions and extra Actions remain target-controlled. Hostile conduct uses ordinary initiative before execution, never a free virtual pre-initiative attack.
historicalOriginalSharedProposal.newCompanionBinding: NEW for an actually eligible Humanoid under Dominate Person, or any eligible Confusion target, using an owner-attached companion chassis: use the actual original-owner regular attached phase, original profile and structural command/offense caps. No independent turn, dominator companion allowance or unwilling owner Bonus Action is created. A pending command reservation can be redirected only for this same companion in this same phase, under the reviewed Dominate Beast bridge; spent or another companion’s reservation cannot be stolen. A repeat WIS save occurs at the end of that real regular attached phase even when no instruction executed; this source-specific checkpoint adds no ordinary START/END, recharge or other condition tick. If no such phase is currently supplied, only an END-only six-second save schedule continues, with no orders/actions. On transitioning to actual phases, map the next unresolved save to the next regular phase end, preserve resolved saves and the original maximum, and never replay an opportunity. This extension is proposed explicitly; it is not already conferred by Dominate Beast.
historicalOriginalSharedProposal.newEndSaveBinding: NEW: Overwhelming Grief, Charm Monster, Erase Emotion and Phantasmal Killer use affected regular-END saves, including an affected current turn, without extra-turn saves. Outside initiative their first END-only save is at application +6 seconds and then each six seconds. On entering initiative map the next unresolved save to the next actual regular END, retain completed saves and the original absolute maximum, and do not add an immediate transition save. For an owner-attached target, use its actual regular attached-phase end with the same END-only fallback/transition above, granting no actions. Dominate Person and Confusion instead use their shared behavior cycle and companion binding.
historicalOriginalSharedProposal.newCompanionPulseBinding: NEW for Illusion Phantasmal Killer on an owner-attached companion: its periodic packet uses the beginning of the actual original-owner regular attached phase, after that phase’s required processing, under the same once-per-numbered-round exposure. It creates no independent START or other start-trigger event. If no actual phase exists, use only the six-second damage schedule and original deadline, granting no actions. Transition to a real phase maps the next unresolved pulse opportunity without replaying an initial or completed pulse. Its separately scheduled repeat save still follows the END-only bridge.

historicalOriginalIssues: Fate Reversal proposes extending the currently two-spell Mark Omen/Fate Coin guard. Adoption would require an explicit shared-rule amendment, not an implied change from this index.
Seal Vision deliberately protects against noninformational Divination too, while Protection from Scrying remains information-only. Its self-protection exemption requires joint review.

Resonance Sight is currently a reviewed cantrip with exact RP aura information. Resonance Divination preserves its source rank and 60-foot snapshot but has a substantial overlap; do not describe the lower spell as merely qualitative.
Dominate Person full control remains bounded by current agency and resource rules. The proposed companion repeat-save bridge and Confusion table are new authoring, not existing approved behavior.
Mass Pacify uses the narrower actual-attack category and per-target attacked release, unlike Group Pacify’s broader harm/provocation. Its breadth and rank value need explicit discussion.
Confusion keeps Enchantment and Illusion target/range modes separate. The concentration requirement and Illusion duration/save are added explicitly.

Phantasmal Killer keeps Enchantment initial damage separate from Illusion recurring damage. Fear immunity does not remove independently established damage; current fear geometry and information limits remain.
Erase Emotion targets actual rage-state/Frightened-generating components, including parts of mixed abilities. No source is classified by a suggestive name alone.
